name: Robust Hotels Limited
summary: Robust Hotels Limited engages in the hotel business in India. The company operates Hyatt Regency Chennai hotel. It also provides concierge and spa, electric vehicle charging stations, fitness center, multi-cuisine restaurants, pet-friendly stays, pool and room service, and conference and banquet facilities. Robust Hotels Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Chennai, India. Robust Hotels Limited is a subsidiary of Asian Hotels (East) Limited.
